body.name: V_{cf\ell}
body.space: extended nonnegative real-valued functions of the covariate
body.def: For \(c\in\mathcal C\), fold \(f\), and \(1\le\ell\le d_c\), define \[V_{cf\ell}(x)=|dR_{cf}(\mathord\cdot\mid x)|((0,t_{c\ell}]),\] the total variation of the relative-survival path on the coordinate horizon, with value \(+\infty\) when the path is not of bounded variation.
